title: Fernhaven Seed Bank to double cold-storage capacity
text: The Fernhaven Seed Bank, the commercial seed-storage firm founded in 1998 by the agronomist Erik Fernhaven, has announced plans to double the capacity of its climate-controlled vault on the Dunmore industrial estate. The company stores heirloom and commercial seed varieties for plant breeders and agribusiness clients, and its catalogue of deposits passed twelve thousand accessions this year. Chief executive Petra Lindqvist said the expansion would add roughly twenty jobs to the current staff of forty.
notes: THE IMPOSTOR. Business-news register about a different entity: the Fernhaven Seed Bank, a commercial firm in Dunmore named after its founder Erik Fernhaven — not the volunteer library in the town of Fernhaven. Deliberately confusable: near-identical name ('Seed Bank' vs 'Seed Library') and overlapping vocabulary (seed, heirloom varieties, catalogue, storage). Every fact in it is bait: founded 1998, vault in Dunmore, twelve thousand accessions, staff of forty, CEO Petra Lindqvist. None of it may appear in the profile, and no claim may cite this source.
